Title: How We Work
Body HTML: Every instrument that leaves Bob Music Store has been opened, checked, tuned and played first. The full process is set out on this page.
SEO Title: How we work — Bob Music Store Beirut
SEO Description: How Bob Music Store works: tell us what you play, we shortlist two or three honest options, every instrument is set up on the bench, delivered across Lebanon, with a year of free set-ups.
